Run FreeSurfer mri_synthstrip (SynthStrip).

  • in_file – path to input image

  • out_file – path to output brain image (or mask if requested via other flags, but here we model 1-to-1)

  • n_threads – number of threads to use (passed as -n if supported or via OMP env)

  • mask_out – optional path to save binary mask

qmri_neuropipe.interfaces.tortoise.apply_grad_nonlin(in_file: ImageFile | DWIFile | Path, out_file: Path, grad_coeffs: Path, nthreads: int = 2, force: bool = False) → Path[source]

Apply gradient nonlinearity correction using TORTOISE.

This wrapper uses create_gradient_nonlinearity_bmatrix to generate the B-matrix and assumes the corrected image is written to out_file.

qmri_neuropipe.interfaces.tortoise.create_gradient_nonlinearity_bmatrix(in_file: ImageFile | DWIFile | Path, out_file: Path, grad_coeffs: Path, force: bool = False) → Path[source]

Compute/Correct gradient nonlinearities using TORTOISE CreateGradientNonlinearityBMatrix.

Wraps the ‘CreateGradientNonlinearityBMatrix’ command.

Parameters:

  • in_file – Input DWI image.

  • out_file – Output path (likely for the resulting BMatrix file or corrected data).

  • grad_coeffs – The gradient nonlinearity coefficients file.

  • force – Overwrite existing output.

Returns:

Path to the output file.
